title: Company Library
content: # **Objective** ![Size=2XL 200, RVS=OFF.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778222566297) | Company Library is a cloud repository that helps brands store, source, manage, and share essential digital contents. You can use Company Library to centralize and organize brand logo, virtual fabric/trim, block pattern, avatar/dummy, and more. ---|--- 1. Accessibility 2. Favorite 3. Search 4. Turn On/Off Company Library # **Details** ### 1) Accessibility Company Library can be accessed by both Company Admin and Collaborator as well as the Brand Admin and Brand Collaborator under that Company. But it could additionally be shared to other users as Company Library Editor or Viewer. You may think of Company Library as a**separate workspace to store/share common assets** , so the permission for Company Library is also separate from other workrooms in the Company. | Download | Upload | Delete ---|---|---|--- Company Admin / Collaborator Brand Admin / Collaborator | o | o | o Company Library Editor | o | o | x Company Library Viewer | x | x | x ## ### 2) Favorite** ** ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.20.23 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778208395417) You can designate Company Library into Favorites by clicking the icon ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778239133081), and enter Favorite Company Library, Workroom or content page using the Shortcut menu on the left side of the page. ### 3) Search for Content Name & ID ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.22.37 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778239244953) You can also search for Content Name or ID by using [Search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161) function on each Space page. ※Note: What is Content Type & ID? [Click here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) ### 4) Turn On/Off Company Library ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.23.32 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778208975385) Company Admin can turn on/off Company Library Function. ※Note: Please refer to [Company Setting](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) to manage/set Company’s space.
content_description: The Company Library serves as a centralized cloud repository for brands to efficiently store, manage, and share essential digital assets while ensuring controlled access for various user roles.

title: Sort By
content: **Objective** Utilize 'Sort by' option to manage your view. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821365130521) 1. Sorting Options 2. Where can I use it? 3. Sorting Option by User # **Details** ### 1) Sorting Options When viewing the list of Contents, Rooms, or Spaces, you can use the 'Sort By' option. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821303147801) 1. **Last Modified (Default)** : default in descending order. Based on the latest updated date of the Content/Room 2. **Name** : Alphabetic order of the name of Content/Room 3. **Workflow** : In custom Workflow order. [Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) order is customizable in Company Setting page. 4. **Custom View** : Create custom order for your Workroom or Company Library. Click 'Change Order' button next to the 'Sort By' button to create a custom order. Manually change the order of your Contents, and click 'Save'. (*Custom Views are only available in Workroom and Company Library.) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821349000345) ### 2) Where can I use it? * **Sorting Space** * * Workspace tab * Sorting options: Last Modified, Name ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821336931097) * * Company, Brand, Line, Season, Assortment * Sorting options: Last Modified, Name ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821349597849) * #### **Sorting Contents** * In Workroom & Company Library * Sorting options: Last Modified, Name, Workflow, Custom ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821335487897) * * Workspace > Contents * Sorting options: Last Modified, Name, Workflow ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45821350242073) ### ### 3) Sorting Option by User * For each user, CLO-SET will save the selected 'sort by' and 'descending/ascending' option to synchronize the view throughout the service. * **Applied to** : All pages with Sort By option, except Visual Board. In all Groups the user visits (sort by selection is saved even after switching to a different Group). * **Rules** : Last selected 'Sort By' option will follow the user throughout CLO-SET. * **Exception** : * 'Custom' option will not be saved. Once you refresh or revisit the page, sorting option will return to the default setting ('Last Modified'). * If you move from a page that **DOES** have 'Workflow' option to a page that does **NOT,** sorting option will return to the default setting ('Last Modified'). * ex. If you move from Workroom page with 'Workflow' sorting selected > go to Company space, your sorting option will be reset to 'Last Modified' in the Company page. * If you are accessing the CLO-SET page directly with a URL that includes sorting options, your view will match the information provided in the URL.
content_description: The purpose of this webpage is to guide users on how to effectively utilize the 'Sort by' option to customize their view of Contents, Rooms, and Spaces within the CLO-SET platform.

title: Recent vs. Updated Contents
content: # **Objective** Understand how CLO-SET defines 'Recent' and 'Updated' Contents on the Dashboard. 1. Recent Contents 2. Updated Contents 3. Dashboard / Workspace / Select Modals # **Details** ### 1) Recent Contents * Recent Contents list, or Recently Viewed Contents list, displays the Contents that you have recently viewed or uploaded (including Version uploads) within each Group. ### 2) Updated Contents * Updated Contents displays the Contents with latest updates or those that have been shared to you recently. * What's considered an 'update'? * Upload (including Versions) * Comment & replies * Move Content * Copy Content * Workflow change/delete ### 3) Dashboard/ Workspace / Select Modals List of 'Recent' and 'Upadted' Contents can be found on multiple pages throughout CLO-SET. * Dashboard View ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777907808281) * Workspace Tab ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777926876057) * Select Modals ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777951628953)
content_description: This web page aims to clarify CLO-SET's definitions of 'Recent' and 'Updated' contents on the Dashboard, detailing how these categories are displayed across various sections of the platform.

title: Content Information Fields
content: # **Objective** Learn about Content Information Fields in CLO-SET and how to effectively utilize the feature. 1. What is Content Information Field? 2. Field Management * Default Fields * Custom Fields * *Number Type Fields 3. Input/View Content Information 4. Permission # # **Detail** ### 1) What is Content Information Field? ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897586713) * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ### ### 2) Field Management **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778881725081) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. * ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778943746585) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912589465) ---|--- #### **2\. Custom Fields** * Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778912761113) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904421913) ---|--- * To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. * Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. * Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. * To **delete** the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. #### **3\. 'Number' Type Fields** **Unit Options** | **Currency Options for Price** | **Unit Format Example** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778913205657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778904807833) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778916815001) * When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. * Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. **Placeholder** | **Explanation** ---|--- 0 | The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # | The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) | Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) | Specifies a thousands separator in a number ### 3) Input/View Content Information **Permission** : All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information / Viewers are read only ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778916995225) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897586713) * Go to Content Page, and click the 'Expand' button on the left pane. * Once the Content Field section is open, click on the field to begin entering the information. * Any information added or edited will be saved immediately as entered. Exiting the Content Field tab will NOT undo the changes. ### ### 4) Permission * Field Management: by Group Admin or Company Admin at Company Settings page * Input/View Content Information: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit field information. Viewers are read only
content_description: This webpage aims to educate users on the Content Information Fields feature in CLO-SET, providing guidance on its management, customization, and effective utilization for enhanced asset management.

title: Video Viewer
content: # **Objective** Play video files directly on the CLO-SET Viewer and upload video clips as attachment. 1. [Requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J1VSQBX2AJ2EVJ9A8D4XT0AS) 2. [How to](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J8EVACKYBXB5AE56Q628TTCY) # **Details** ### 1) Requirements * **Compatible File Format** : MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, FLV, MPEG-2 TS, MPEG-2 PS, MXF, LXF, GXF, 3GP, WebM, MPG, and QuickTime. * Maximum file size up to **200MB**. ### 2) How to ![video viewer.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778624804377) * Upload a Video file in your [Workroom](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) * On the [Content](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303210570649) page, click on the 'Play' button (▶) to start playing the clip * Clicking on the viewer again will pause the clip. Manage volume and settings the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778639998489) 1. **Viewer Selector[Thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129):** First frame of the uploaded video file 2. **Content Info[Thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129)**: Expand the Content Info tab to change the Thumbnail to be displayed on Workroom View 3. **Video Viewer Settings** * Play/Pause * Volume * Quality * Speed * Picture-in-picture mode * Full Screen 4. **Attachment** : Attach a video file to the uploaded Content. Same [requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10730582382863#h_01J1VSQBX2AJ2EVJ9A8D4XT0AS) apply for file compatibility.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide users with the ability to play video files and upload video clips as attachments on the CLO-SET Viewer, along with detailed requirements and step-by-step instructions.

title: Render Error
content:
## **Objective** Troubleshooting error when requesting Render on CLO-SET or through API. Find the description of the error message, and learn how to solve the issue. 1. Troubleshooting Error 2. Checking Rendering & Server Status ## **Details** ### 1) Troubleshooting Render Error ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777955383833)
``` **Error** : Unexpected Error has occurred. Please check your file.
``` For this error message, considering checking below: * **Issue: Converting incomplete** * Please try again once the Content converting is complete. Render cannot be initiated while converting is in process. For newly uploaded files, this may take up to 3 minutes. If the converting failed, please contact us with the content page URL for support. * **Issue: Render size too big** * Width & height of the requested Render must be equal or less than 5000px. * **Issue: Invalid File Type** * Rendering is available for 3D files only. * Rendering is not supported for Blank Contents. Check [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * **Issue: Missing mandatory information from the API request** * Preset ZVRP information missing. When uzeZVRP=true, then presetSeq field is mandatory. * Render Setting information is mandatory. Check the renderableScene field. * Invalid parameters. Requested Item Version cannot be set as 0. * Check Group information. The requested Group does not exist, or the user is not the member of the requested Group. * Check Render Preset. The requested presetSeq does not exist. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777930549273)
``` **Error** : Unexpected Error has occurred. Please report the issue HERE
``` For this error message, please [create a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new). Please include the Content Page URL for faster support. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777955725465)
``` **Error** : You have reached the allowed numbers of jobs that can be requested to Rendering queue.
``` For this error message, please wait until the requested Rendering is complete, to request a new task. Each CLO-SET Group can only request up to 100 Render tasks simultaneously. ### 2) Checking Rendering & Server Status * **Rendering Status** : While the Render is in process, you can view the status of your Render task. Click on the Render Thumbnail on the left of the Viewer to find the status, estimated time, and completion rate. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777930923801) * **Rendering Server Status** : Check the Rendering Server status for your Group. Hover over the 'Render' icon above the Version list to view the Server status and the number of Render queues in your Group. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777946389785)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for troubleshooting rendering errors on CLO-SET, providing detailed descriptions of common issues and solutions to ensure successful rendering requests through the platform or API.

title: Content Type & ID
content: # **Objective** Any 3D/2D/other files uploaded on CLO-SET is designated as a Content. For each Content, you may identify the Content Type to be used throughout CLO-SET, including Tech Pack and Line Sheet. You may also search for relevant Content Type & ID by using [General Search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002203035) Function. 1. Content Type 2. Content ID 3. Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) # **Details** ### 1) Content Type Every Content is classified as a single Content Type in CLO-SET. At the time of upload, you may select the Content Type. Or, for specific file formats, CLO-SET will automatically assign a Content Type. *Any zprj/zpac files uploaded will automatically be identified as a Style Content Type. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370822937)![Table \(1\) copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778335640729) #### ### 2) Content ID Content ID is a unique ID auto-assigned by CLO-SET upon file upload. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.40.25 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778371109785) * Content created on or after April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Content created before April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **3 letter Prefix** (Content Type) **\+ 6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Prefix List: ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778371347353) ### 3) Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) You may add Fabric/Graphic/Trim information on [Web Tech Pack](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) \- BOM tab. Please note that the file format needs to match the Content Type to be added on BOM. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.44.59 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778336186777)
content_description: This page serves as a guide for uploading and categorizing 3D/2D files on CLO-SET, detailing the Content Types, unique Content IDs, and their integration into Web Tech Packs.

title: Permission Approval
content: # **Objective** Activate the Permission Approval system for advanced security of your Group & Assets 1. [What is Permission Approval?](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JEZKN6PS4S2A2SET8CM0GAMS) 2. [Activate Permission Approval](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JK5E8WM72NX994MRHBYN9SPQ) 3. [Inviting Users](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#h_01JK5EP2YEQ3K57G701VKG4RAN) 4. [Approve/Reject Permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#01JK5GFJY9GN2ZYH4FQ5DTZY13) 5. Console > User History > Permission Approval # **Details** ### 1) What is Permission Approval? * Permission Approval is an optional feature that allows Group Admin/Group Operators to review & confirm the users being invited before they gain access to the Group. * It allows managers to fully own the invitations being made to the Group, for advanced security and control over subscription fees. * Please note: activating the option may hinder new invitees from gaining instant access to the Group. ### 2) Activate Permission Approval #### Permission: Group Admin ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118157209)/ Group Operator * To activate the Permission Approval for your Group, visit Console > Settings > Group Settings * Click the Toggle to activate, and hit 'OK' on the pop-up modal * Note: Permission Approval is turned **off** as default | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778162619417) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118508953) ---|---|--- ### 3) Inviting Users * When Permission Approval option is activated, status of the new member will be displayed as below. * **Pending** : indicates that the invitee has not created a CLO-SET account yet * **Pre-****approval** : indicates that the Group Admin/Operator has not approved the permission yet * When a new user is invited, Group Admin/Operator will receive a notification email to [take action](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11866755807887#01JK5GFJY9GN2ZYH4FQ5DTZY13) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134012313) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778179015065) * Once Group Admin/Operator approves the new member, they will receive an email notification, along with an access link ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134379545) ### 4) Approve/Reject Users #### Permission: Group Admin ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778118157209)/ Group Operator * Whenever a new member is invited to the Group, Group Admin/Operator will receive an email to approve the new member. Click 'Go to Use Administration' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778179015065) * In Console > Permission Approval > Pending Users tab, click 'Approve' or 'Reject' * Note: once approved, the new member will receive an email notification ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134803737) ### 5) Console > User History > Permission Approval * On the Console > User History > Permission Approval tab, you can find the full list of approved/pending/rejected users **[All User Status]** Displays the full list of users invited to the Group (including approved, pending, removed) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778134995353) * * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the two: * Active: User accepted with access * Removed: User removed from Group * Clicking on the active user's account email to view [Permission Management](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649) info for the selected account **[Pending Users]** Displays the list of requests that are pending/rejected ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778180105369) * **Status** of the accounts are displayed as one of the four below: **Status** | **Action/Next Step** | **Details** ---|---|--- Pending | Approve / Reject | Pending request. Group Admin/Operator can approve or reject the request. Approved | Request approved, but the end user is not registered in CLO-SET yet. Rejected | Reapprove | Request rejected. Group Admin/Operator can re-approve the request. * Once the new member is approved, the user will be deleted from the 'pending users' tab (but continue to display on the 'all user status' tab) * If the same user has been invited multiple times, approving the user on any 1 of the rows will automatically approve all requests
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide Group Admins and Operators in activating and managing the Permission Approval system to enhance security and control over their group and assets.

title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Overview
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778236349849) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778176661273) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778176800537) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778220879897) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- 'Overview' allows you to check the overall info of the 3D Content & manage the production schedule ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.14.56 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778177241625) 1. Summary * Which fields are editable? 2. Schedule 3. Requirement & Permission 4. [WTP General Guide](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) ### 1) Summary Information on the Summary tab is synched with the Style info tab on your Content page, including the [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) Manage and edit details, and create additional fields by clicking 'ADD INFORMATION' button. *The additional information tab will not be reflected back on the Content Page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778177355417) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778237535001) ---|---|--- * #### Which Fields are Editable? * Content Name * Company / Brand / Season / Line / Workroom * Workflow * Creator/Created Date * Thumbnail * Tags * Category * Description * [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) ### 2) Schedule Add Schedule and Meeting links for each style to track the production schedule & timeline. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.48.39 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778199619225) | | ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 10.48.52 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778237891225) ---|---|--- 1. Create Schedule and timeline for each phase 2. Share meeting links or external links on the Schedule tab for the team #### ### 3) Requirement & Permission * Content Type: for a WTP to be created, the [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) must be 'Style' * if the 1st version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file, then the Content Type will automatically update to 'Style' * if the Content Type is NOT 'Style', then Web Tech Pack will not be activated even if the last version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file. * if the Content Type is 'Styl'e but the uploaded version is NOT a zpac/zprj file (ex. blank content, jpeg, fab, etc), then Web Tech Pack will be activated but it will not be able to load any data. * Access the Tech Pack page by clicking the ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778220879897) (Web Tech Pack) button from Content page * You must have [Admin / Collaborator / Editor](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) permission to view the Web Tech Pack *For Image files: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778207881241) *For Blank Contents: ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778222402073)

title: Billing & Payment Email Notification
content: # **Objective** Understand the types of email notification you receive from CLO-SET regarding payment and plan. 1. Who receives the updates? 2. Payment/Invoice * Complete * Failed / Cancelled 3. New user (additional charges) 4. Plan change * Upgrade * Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit # **Details** ### 1) Who receives the updates? * **Group Admin** and **Group Operators** will be notified of the updates on payment/plan/charges of the Group. Group Admin is the owner account of the Group and cannot be changed. However, you may add/edit Group Operators on[ Console - Settings - Group Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049). * Learn more about CLO-SET[ Permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) * Please note that payment/plan related notifications cannot be turned off. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778680367513) ### 2) Payment/Invoice * ### Complete * When the Group initiates or renews the plan and the payment has been complete successfully, you will receive below notification. #### | #### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778743297177) | 1. **Invoice/Charges** * List the invoice and details including the invoice number, issued date, and item details 2. **Carryover Balance (if applicable)** * If your Group has addition/deduction credits from the previous measurement, it will be applied to your payment. Learn more from [billing guideline](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361). 3. **Payment Total** * Total amount paid by the Group on the noted date. ---|---|--- * ### Failed / Cancelled * You will receive a notification if a payment attempt fails. * CLO-SET offers a **5-day grace period** with 3 automatic payment retries. Your subscription will remain active during this time. If payment is completed within the grace period, your subscription and billing cycle continue as usual; otherwise, your subscription will be cancelled. * Once the grace period is over, your card payment will be cancelled along with your subscription. ### 3) New User (Additional Charges) * When there is an update on your Group member list, it will be reflected on your [Billing History](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257). You will be notified of such updates via email. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778743551257) ### 3) Plan Change * When there is an update on your subscription or plan, you will receive an email notification. * ### Upgrade * When you upgrade your plan from Standard to Premium, changes will be made instantly. The unused amounts will be refunded in the form of credit to be used on your upgrade payment. * You will receive a notification detailing the new plan and paid amount as displayed here. * ### Downgrade / Settled Addition Credit * When you downgrade your plan, you will receive email notification. Please note that the downgrade will take place after your current measurement period is over. * If your group has addition credit due to adding more users within the previous measurement cycle, you will be charged for the addition credit at the end of your subscription. Once this amount is paid, your Group will be downgraded to the Free plan.
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the types of email notifications sent by CLO-SET regarding payment status, plan changes, and user additions for Group Admins and Operators.
